name: Intercom
description: Intercom is a customer-service platform combining a shared support inbox, business messaging, help-center content, automation, and AI-assisted service. Support teams use it to organize customer conversations, coordinate responses, route work, and understand service demand.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Intercom workspace through Relay Console OAuth, then let agents use three bounded read-only tools for the conversation count and privacy-redacted conversation metadata. Relay V1 excludes message content, contacts, teammate identities, conversation parts, attachments, tags, custom attributes, writes, searches, pagination, exports, administration, and broader Intercom products.

webhookRequirements: Optional uninstall notification; runtime health and local disconnect still fail closed without it.

providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, complete the icon, terms, pricing, screenshots, health-check URL, and end-to-end OAuth video, submit the existing app for public or unlisted review, add the approved staging credentials, then verify exact workspace/region/admin binding, all three reads, permission denial, provider uninstall, local disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Public apps that access other customers' workspaces must use OAuth; requesting customer access tokens is prohibited.
Intercom uses an HTTPS form-post callback, state-bound authorization, the Eagle token exchange, and selectable Read conversations and Read admins permissions.
The OAuth-only /me endpoint returns the exact authorizing admin, email-verification state, workspace id/name, and workspace region; unverified identities must be rejected.
Intercom provides fixed US, EU, and AU REST origins; Relay binds subsequent requests to the region returned by /me.
API 2.15 provides bounded conversation list/count metadata and exact conversation retrieval; Relay fixes page size, does not accept cursors, and redacts message/contact/part content.
Public third-party installation requires OAuth, and POST /auth/uninstall revokes an app token; uninstall notifications are optional.
